summary: GI round 4, package PV1: E/M reading fixes (C1, C2) and the C4 holds, plus V3's hold-only nouns. Edits only cues.EM_TIME_ACTIVITIES, NOT_IN_PERSON, NOT_IN_PERSON_TITLE (new) and MDM_LEVEL (a third prefix sharing the 'level' group; read only by detect); detect._em_base_reading, _clause_reading_cues and _cue_reading (an 'activities' parameter, default None = installed), _not_in_person, EM_NOT_IN_PERSON, EM_ANOTHER_TIME and new _pv1_* helpers; checks._VAL_SERVICE_NOUNS. Nothing context.py or sections.py reads changes, so the request side cannot move: no cue the freeze inventories is added or changed, and the date channel, every request's bytes, every layout and both mention counts are unchanged. Every movement is in routing's gi.office_em reading and the E/M codes that follow it. Declared before any code was written; the base is installed 80df1831d168 (stage A's head 1e0733feb equals it on every pin).

rules.C1: an E/M time statement followed directly by 'covering', 'including', 'spent on' (or the prototype's synonyms) lists the visit's own work: clause cues and dates at or after that word never re-time the statement; cues before it still do; em-time mentions only
rules.C2: an inline 'complexity of decision making: X' / 'level of decision making: X' (':' or '-' after the label) gives MDM level X; 'shared decision making' never gives a level; the existing 'medical decision making' / 'MDM' readings are unchanged
rules.C4: a performed E/M reading of any kind (visit statement, heading, time, MDM) is held (uncertain, doubt) when the note says the patient was not seen in person, has no in-person contact, was seen by telephone or phone call (telephone/phone encounter, call, visit, follow-up, note; by/via/over the telephone or phone; telephonic; audio-only), was a no-show or did not arrive/attend/show up: anywhere outside plan and history sections, in a head title line whatever its section, or in the E/M statement's own sentence. Video, telehealth and virtual visits are NOT held. A reading installed already holds or reads not-performed is returned unchanged (no exclusion becomes a hold through C4)
rules.C4-time: installed's _another_time now also holds a performed E/M time statement ('Total time at her last visit was 40 minutes.')
rules.V3: _VAL_SERVICE_NOUNS gains imaging and laboratory nouns (ultrasound, sonogram, sonography, elastography, CT, MRI, MRCP, x-ray, scan, blood work, panel); it only turns an E/M code's own negative reading about another service into a hold
